caveat: No assurance of Secure Channel Protocol (SCP) message integrity
description: Authentication Token is a Cryptographic Module containing Thales' authenticated Java applets. Authentication Token is compliant with the latest Java Card 2.2.2 and GlobalPlatform 2.1.1 specifications and is validated to FIPS 140-2 Level 3. Authentication Token supports FIPS-Approved: DRBG; SHA-1 and all SHA-2; TDES; AES; ECDSA and ECC CDC; and, RSA and ECC key generation. Authentication Token is designed to provide users of Thales' hardware security modules with high-performance smart card capabilities in support of their government and enterprise applications.
firmware_versions: Athena IDProtect 010B.0333.0004 with Authentication Token Applet 1.0

other_fields.Historical Reason: Moved to historical list in accordance with SP800-131A Revision 1 Transition (AES/TDES key wrapping)
other_fields.Other Algorithms: HW RNG; AES-CMAC (non-compliant); EC Diffie-Hellman (key agreement; key establishment methodology provides 256 bits of encryption strength); AES (Cert. #1654, key wrapping; key establishment methodology provides 256 bits of encryption strength)
